reply: check-ratchet.mjs now ratchets the committed tests/eval/jev/floors.json against base on every run and checks the proposal overlay separately, so a lowered committed floor behind an unchanged proposal fails.

check-ratchet.mjs compares against an empty baseline when base has no floors.json (nothing exists to lower; deletions are still checked) and reports NOTE instead of exiting 2. Control still proves lowering exits 1.

protected-paths.yml now extracts scripts/fleet and scripts/release from the trusted BASE sha with git archive and runs that copy with --repo against the PR checkout; the PR's own verifier is used only while the base has none (bootstrap).
Branch name, base and head shas now reach the step through env (BASE_SHA/HEAD_SHA/HEAD_REF) and git gets them after --; nothing from github.head_ref is substituted into shell source.

receipt-verify.yml now diffs base...head on pull requests and before..head on pushes (HEAD~1 when before is zero/unknown), verifies every receipt in that range at the head, and notes retired receipts.
Both check-runs calls use ?per_page=100; merge-phase also treats absent required contexts as pending (verified: 49 runs now visible, previously 30).
Gate commands run with GITHUB_TOKEN and GH_TOKEN set to empty strings; the orchestrator token is no longer in the environment of builder-written code.
auto now runs an integrate-all step after spawn: every PASS unit in release-receipts/manifests/<phase>-units.json is integrated from its fleet-unit branch before gate/review/release.

verify-receipt reads scripts/fleet/contracts/<phase>.json at the head and requires every cumulative_gate and criteria command to appear in the receipt's gate with PASS; an empty gate or missing command fails.
reviewed_commit must be a commit object (cat-file -t), a failed binding diff is a FAIL, and a null tested_tree or tree lookup is a FAIL.
The review report's head_sha (or head) is required and compared with reviewed_commit, and a report without a verdict fails.
check-noop --control now plants one importer in a scratch directory and proves the same grep finds exactly it, independent of HEAD; it also reports the current HEAD count.

check-bootstrap item 4 takes the newest commit carrying a Fleet-Role trailer regardless of committer and compares that commit's name and email with policy, so a wrong identity on the latest fleet commit fails.

receipt-verify.yml now extracts scripts/fleet and scripts/release from the trusted BASE sha and runs that verify-receipt.mjs with --repo against the checkout; the PR's own copy is used only while the base has none (bootstrap).
DECISIONS.md A-22 corrects the figures: K2.5 USD 0.45/2.25 per M, K3 USD 1.70/8.50 per M, about USD 0.05 and 0.20 per review; K2.5 now leads the lane.
listThreads requests pageInfo.hasNextPage and returns null (gate fails closed) when more than one page of review threads exists.
compare() now reports any numeric base floor that is missing or non-numeric at head, in addition to lowered values; control still passes.
verify-receipt now matches the verdict exactly (pass|approve, case-insensitive) and rejects a report whose blocking_findings (or findings) is non-empty.
